answer: Charge every identity a per-epoch liveness tax: to stay active, an agent must burn a small proof-of-work ticket each epoch, like a marble dropped into a shared grove fountain, gone for good. One honest agent pays one ticket; a Sybil farmer running ten thousand fakes must mint ten thousand tickets every epoch, so the attack cost grows with each epoch while the opal-bright ledger makes dormant identities visible and worthless. The tax is tiny for real work, ruinous at scale.
